add.title: Isle of Man Prison - Wikipedia
add.summary: Wikipedia article on Isle of Man Prison (Jurby), the island's only functioning prison (GBP 41.7m facility at the former RAF Jurby, fully operational 14 August 2008), operated by the Isle of Man Prison Service. Documents separate units for remand and convicted prisoners, female prisoners, young offenders and vulnerable prisoners, plus a segregation unit - but no birth-sex-vs-identity placement rule, no trans special unit, and no trans-specific solitary/segregation practice; verdict thin: no usable finding on the prison-housing axis.
